title: HttpConfig
description:
Configuration for the HTTP transport.

The HTTP transport is a fallback for environments where gRPC is unavailable or blocked. Ingest routes are appended by the client at call time; `base_url` is the common prefix.

This config carries transport wiring only. Authentication is owned by `AuthMiddleware`, which injects the `x-wyrd-access-token` credential per call; there is no auth field here.

base_url.description:
Base URL for all ingest routes. Must be non-empty. Ingest routes (`/api/v1/observations`, `/api/v1/records`, etc.) are appended at call time.

Example: `"https://wyrd-ingest.example.com"`. Default: [`HTTP_DEFAULT_BASE_URL`] (`"http://localhost:8080"`).

compression.description:
Whether to gzip-compress request bodies. Useful for high-volume payloads; the server must accept `Content-Encoding: gzip`.

Default: `false`.

timeout_ms.description:
HTTP timeout in milliseconds with two uses: it bounds connection establishment for every call, and it bounds the total request/response duration only for retried JSON and control calls. Streaming transfers and terminal query streams have no total deadline from this value.

Default: [`HTTP_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS`] (`30_000`, 30 s).
